headline: Aniimo Element Chart
title: Aniimo Element Chart Explained | Weakness Damage and Resistances | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want to win more fights in Aniimo? Learn the element chart. There are nine elements. Hit a weakness and you deal one point six times damage. Hit a resistance and it drops to about sixty percent. There are no immunities, so every attack still lands. Many Aniimo have two elements, which changes their weaknesses, so bring a mixed team and switch to the right type. Which element do you use most? Comment below!
description: Aniimo element chart: nine elements, 1.6x damage on a weakness, about 0.6x on a resistance, no immunities; dual-element Aniimo change their weaknesses.
